title: Mobile Wallet Shortfalls: When the Shortfall Period Starts
content:
Disputes team counting convention for **Mobile Wallet** incorrect-amount errors: the date from which the days a shortfall stood are counted.

**Convention.** The starting date is set by how soon the customer gave notice, measured in calendar days from the date available to the notice date:

| Notice given, in calendar days after the date available | Days the shortfall stood are counted from |
|---|---|
| 3 or fewer | the date available |
| 4 to 30 | the notice date |
| more than 30 | the date of the error-found decision itself |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, date available 2026-05-01)

| Notice date | Days after the date available | Counting starts |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-05-04 | 3 | 2026-05-01, the date available |
| 2026-05-05 | 4 | 2026-05-05, the notice date |
| 2026-05-31 | 30 | 2026-05-31, the notice date |
| 2026-06-01 | 31 | the decision date |
